Which state transition turns a player-requested feed release into paired release and FeedInterrupt?

findings.fact: The four client command-name strings have unique absolute references in the pinned image.
findings.evidence: +attack2/-attack2 at 0x102bdbd8/0x102bdbe4 are referenced at 0x1010509c/0x101050ec; +wpn_secondaryatk/-wpn_secondaryatk at 0x102bdd58/0x102bdd6c are referenced at 0x10105ccc/0x10105d1c.
findings.consequence: The registration sites give bounded entry points for recovering both press/release handler pairs without guessing from key bindings.

findings.fact: +attack2 owns the ordinary attack2 kbutton and contributes held bit 0x00000800 plus press-edge bit 0x01000000.
findings.evidence: The registered handlers at 0x10102130/0x10102140 press/release kbutton 0x104d2da0; the client button pack at 0x10104460 assigns it masks 0x00000800 and 0x01000000.
findings.consequence: +attack2 alone does not produce the server block bit.

findings.fact: +wpn_secondaryatk is a held composite block command, not a persistent toggle.
findings.evidence: The handlers at 0x101024e0/0x101024f0 press/release kbutton 0x104d36e0 through 0x10102250/0x10102260 and then tail-jump to the ordinary +attack2/-attack2 handlers. The button pack emits 0x104d36e0 as held bit 0x08000000.
findings.consequence: While held, +wpn_secondaryatk contributes both ordinary attack2 state and the distinct block bit consumed by the server player classifier.

findings.fact: +feed and -feed own one ordinary client kbutton and pack its held state as usercmd bit 0x00400000.
findings.evidence: +feed/-feed at 0x102bdd14/0x102bdd1c have unique registration references at 0x10105a9c/0x10105aec; handlers 0x10102230/0x10102240 press/release kbutton 0x104d2e40; 0x10104460 packs its held state as 0x00400000.
findings.consequence: The ordinary feed request is a real command-button state, not a one-shot montage or Python-only verb.

functions.label: weapon_secondary_release_handler
functions.role: -wpn_secondaryatk composite handler; releases block state then forwards to -attack2.

functions.label: weapon_secondary_mode_press
functions.role: Presses the separate weapon-secondary block kbutton 0x104d36e0.

functions.label: weapon_secondary_mode_release
functions.role: Releases the separate weapon-secondary block kbutton 0x104d36e0.

functions.label: pack_command_buttons
functions.role: Packs ordinary attack2 as held 0x00000800/edge 0x01000000, weapon-secondary block as held 0x08000000 and feed as held 0x00400000.
